title: 헬스장
scene: 헬스장. 러닝머신 옆자리 하늘이 먼저 말을 건다 — 운동 핑계로
goal: Being approached at the gym (she makes the first move)

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 저기, 이 기구 어떻게 쓰는지 알아?
turns.rd: jeogi, i gigu eotteoke sseuneunji ara?
turns.en: Hey, do you know how to use this machine?

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 아, 이거요? 여기 앉아서 당기면 돼요.
turns.rd: a, igeoyo? yeogi anjaseo danggimyeon dwaeyo.
turns.en: Oh, this one? You sit here and pull.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 아하. 자주 와? 여기서 처음 봐서.
turns.rd: aha. jaju wa? yeogiseo cheoeum bwaseo.
turns.en: I see. You come often? First time I’ve seen you.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Whoa, 7 a.m.? That’s why I never saw you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: When do you usually come, 하늘?

turns.speaker: B
turns.note: Kick: she changes her schedule on the spot

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 그니까. 그러니까 깨워 줘. 번호 주면.
turns.rd: geunikka. geureonikka kkaewo jwo. beonho jumyeon.
turns.en: Exactly. So wake me up. If you give me your number.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 잠깐만… 이 기구, 원래 쓸 줄 알았지?
turns.rd: jamkkanman… i gigu, wollae sseul jul aratji?
turns.en: Wait… you knew how to use this machine all along, didn’t you?
turns.note: 쓸 줄 알다 = know how to use

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Haha, I’ve been coming here three years.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: …I’ll give you my number. Instead of an alarm.
